title: Wireless Keyboard and Mouse Set, 2.4 GHz, Quiet Keys, Full Size
description:
A full-size wireless keyboard and mouse that share one tiny USB receiver, so your desk stays free of cables. Low-profile keys type quietly, which is handy in shared offices and for late-night work.
• 104-key international QWERTY layout with number pad and 12 media shortcut keys
• 2.4 GHz connection with up to 10 m range through one USB-A nano receiver
• Optical mouse with 800 / 1200 / 1600 DPI switch
• Runs on 2 × AA (keyboard) and 1 × AA (mouse) batteries, included
• Keyboard 43.5 × 13 × 2.2 cm, mouse 10.5 × 6 × 3.5 cm

title: Mechanical Keyboard, 87 Keys, Hot-Swappable Switches, RGB Backlight
description:
A compact tenkeyless mechanical keyboard that leaves more desk space for wide mouse movements. The switches pull out without soldering, so you can change the typing feel whenever you like.
• 87-key tenkeyless layout with double-shot PBT keycaps
• Hot-swappable 3- and 5-pin switches; keycap and switch puller included
• 18 RGB lighting effects with adjustable brightness
• Detachable braided USB-C to USB-A cable, 1.8 m
• Full anti-ghosting (N-key rollover); size 36 × 13.5 × 4 cm

title: Ergonomic Wireless Mouse, Rechargeable, Silent Clicks, 6 Buttons
description:
A sculpted mouse with a raised thumb rest that keeps your hand in a relaxed, natural position. Soft-touch buttons click almost silently.
• Dual mode: 2.4 GHz USB receiver plus Bluetooth 5.0, switch between two devices
• 6 buttons including forward and back; DPI steps 800 / 1200 / 1600 / 2400
• Built-in 500 mAh battery, charges via USB-C (cable included)
• Auto-sleep to save power; works with most laptops and PCs

title: Extended Desk Mat 80 × 30 cm, Water-Resistant, Stitched Edges
description:
A large mouse pad that sits under both keyboard and mouse, giving a smooth, even glide and protecting your desk from scratches.
• 80 × 30 cm, 3 mm thick
• Micro-weave fabric surface suited to optical and laser mice
• Natural rubber base that stays in place
• Stitched edges to prevent fraying; wipe clean with a damp cloth

title: Adjustable Aluminium Laptop Stand, Foldable, for 10–17 Inch Laptops
description:
Raises your laptop screen to eye level so you can sit up straight, then folds flat to slip into a laptop bag.
• Sturdy aluminium alloy, holds up to 8 kg
• 6 height settings from 6 to 24 cm
• Open design lets air flow under the laptop to help keep it cool
• Silicone pads protect the laptop and stop it from slipping
• Folded size 24 × 5 × 3 cm, weight 300 g

title: 7-Port USB 3.0 Hub with Individual Power Switches
description:
Turns one USB port into seven, with a switch and LED for every port so you can turn devices on and off without unplugging them.
• 7 × USB-A 3.0 ports, up to 5 Gbps data transfer
• Individual on/off switch and blue LED for each port
• 1 m USB-A cable; plug and play, no drivers needed
• Optional 5 V DC input for power-hungry devices (adapter not included)
• Size 19 × 3.5 × 2 cm

title: 65 W USB-C Laptop Charger, 3 Ports, Compact GaN Design, EU Plug
description:
A compact wall charger that powers USB-C laptops, tablets and phones at full speed, so one plug can replace several bulky adapters.
• 65 W total output with USB Power Delivery 3.0 and PPS
• 2 × USB-C and 1 × USB-A; power is shared automatically when several devices charge
• GaN technology makes it about half the size of a standard laptop adapter
• Protection against overheating, overcurrent and short circuits
• EU plug, 100–240 V; 1.5 m USB-C to USB-C cable included

title: Dual Monitor Arm Desk Mount, Gas Spring, for 13–32 Inch Screens
description:
Lifts two screens off the desk and lets you tilt, swivel and rotate each one on its own, freeing up workspace and putting your monitors at a comfortable height.
• Fits screens 13–32 inch weighing 2–9 kg each, with VESA 75 × 75 or 100 × 100 mounts
• Gas spring arms for smooth height changes; ±90° tilt, 180° swivel, 360° rotation
• Desk clamp (for desks 10–85 mm thick) and grommet base both included
• Built-in cable management clips
• Steel and aluminium construction; all tools and screws included

title: Freestanding Monitor Stand, Height Adjustable, VESA 75/100
description:
A freestanding stand that replaces your monitor's original base, so you can raise, tilt and rotate the screen without clamping anything to the desk.
• Fits 13–27 inch screens up to 7 kg with VESA 75 × 75 or 100 × 100 mounts
• Height adjustable along a 40 cm pole; ±15° tilt and 360° rotation
• Weighted 25 × 20 cm steel base keeps it steady
• Cable clip on the back of the pole; screws and Allen key included

title: 128 GB USB 3.2 Flash Drive, Metal Housing with Keyring Loop
description:
A slim metal USB stick with 128 GB of space for documents, photos and backups, plus a keyring loop so it is always with you.
• 128 GB capacity (about 115 GB usable after formatting)
• USB 3.2 Gen 1 with read speeds up to 120 MB/s; also works in USB 2.0 ports
• Zinc alloy housing with ring for keys or a lanyard
• Plug and play on most PCs, laptops, TVs and car stereos
• Size 3.9 × 1.2 × 0.5 cm

title: Portable SSD 1 TB, USB-C, Read Speeds up to 1050 MB/s
description:
A pocket-sized external SSD for fast backups and moving large video files, with no moving parts to break if it gets knocked.
• 1 TB capacity; read up to 1050 MB/s and write up to 1000 MB/s over USB 3.2 Gen 2
• USB-C port with USB-C to USB-C and USB-C to USB-A cables included
• Aluminium shell with rubber edges, tested for drops up to 2 m
• Works with laptops, desktops, tablets, game consoles and most smartphones
• Size 8.5 × 5.5 × 1 cm, weight 58 g

title: microSDXC Memory Card 128 GB with SD Adapter, U3 V30 A2
description:
A fast memory card that adds storage to phones, action cameras, tablets and handheld consoles; the included adapter lets it work in full-size SD slots too.
• 128 GB capacity, Class 10, UHS-I U3 and V30 for 4K video recording
• A2 rating for quicker app loading on devices that support it
• Read up to 160 MB/s, write up to 90 MB/s
• Water-, temperature- and shock-resistant
• SD adapter included

title: Dual-Band USB Wi-Fi Adapter with 2 Antennas, 1300 Mbps
description:
Adds fast wireless internet to a desktop PC, or replaces a weak built-in laptop connection, with two adjustable antennas for better range through walls.
• Dual band: up to 867 Mbps on 5 GHz plus 400 Mbps on 2.4 GHz
• Two adjustable 5 dBi high-gain antennas
• USB 3.0 connection with a 1.2 m USB extension cradle included
• Supports WPA3 and WPA2 encryption
• Driver download link and quick start guide included

title: Cat6 Flat Ethernet Cable 5 m, Gigabit, Gold-Plated RJ45 Plugs
description:
A flat network cable that tucks under rugs and along skirting boards, for a stable wired connection to your router, console or PC.
• Cat6 standard: up to 1 Gbps with 250 MHz bandwidth
• 5 m long, flat profile only 1.4 mm thin
• Pure copper conductors and gold-plated RJ45 plugs
• Snagless clip covers; 10 cable clips included

title: RGB Case Fans 120 mm, 3-Pack with Hub and Remote Control
description:
Three quiet 120 mm fans that improve airflow through your PC case and add colourful lighting you can change with the included remote.
• 3 × 120 mm fans, 1200 RPM, up to 52 CFM airflow each, under 26 dBA
• Hydraulic bearings for long, quiet running
• Hub and remote included: 10 colours and over 300 lighting modes
• Hub powered from a SATA connector; also works with 5 V 3-pin ARGB headers
• Anti-vibration rubber corners and all mounting screws included

title: Tower CPU Air Cooler with 4 Copper Heat Pipes and 120 mm PWM Fan
description:
A tower-style processor cooler that keeps temperatures down during gaming and heavy workloads, and runs more quietly than most stock coolers.
• 4 direct-contact copper heat pipes with an aluminium fin stack
• 120 mm PWM fan, 800–1800 RPM, 4-pin connector
• Mounting kit for most current desktop CPU sockets; check your socket before ordering
• Height 155 mm, so check the clearance in your case
• Thermal paste pre-applied, plus a spare syringe

title: Adjustable Aluminium Tablet Stand for 4–13 Inch Tablets and Phones
description:
A desk stand that holds a tablet or phone at a comfortable viewing angle for video calls, recipes, reading or drawing.
• Fits devices from 4 to 13 inch, with or without a slim case
• Double hinge adjusts height and angle freely
• Aluminium alloy with a weighted base and silicone pads
• Gap in the holder for a charging cable
• Folds flat for travel, weight 300 g

title: Fine-Tip Active Stylus Pen for Touchscreens, Rechargeable
description:
A fine-tip active stylus for precise writing, sketching and note-taking on most tablet and smartphone touchscreens, with no pairing or app needed.
• 1.5 mm tip for accurate lines; 2 spare tips included
• Works on most capacitive touchscreens without a Bluetooth connection
• Built-in battery charges in about 1 hour via USB-C and lasts around 10 hours
• Switches off automatically after 5 minutes without use
• Aluminium body, 16.5 cm long, 15 g

title: 1080p Full HD Webcam with Dual Microphones and Privacy Cover
description:
A clear, plug-and-play webcam for video calls, online classes and streaming, with a sliding cover for privacy when you are off camera.
• 1920 × 1080 at 30 fps, 90° wide-angle glass lens and automatic light correction
• Two built-in noise-reducing microphones
• Universal clip fits monitors and laptop screens; tripod thread on the base
• 1.5 m USB-A cable; works with common video call apps without drivers

title: USB Headset with Noise-Cancelling Microphone and Inline Controls
description:
A light, padded over-ear headset made for long days of calls and meetings, with a flexible boom mic that reduces background noise.
• Noise-cancelling boom microphone rotates 270° and mutes when raised
• 40 mm drivers with soft faux-leather ear cushions
• Inline control for volume and mute
• USB-A plug plus 3.5 mm jack adapter, 2 m cable
• Adjustable headband, weight 180 g
